verdict.rationale: Medusa documents its own first-party Tax Module, so tax handling is a native capability of this commerce platform. The pack holds only the page title, though, with nothing on how calculation works. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic per-jurisdiction sales tax/VAT calculation, rates kept current automatically, filing-ready tax reports, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, sales tax and VAT are calculated automatically per jurisdiction, with rates kept current and reports I can file from
